issues.detail: The Greek 'τις γαρ σε διακρινει' (For who divides/distinguishes you?) is rendered as 'Vì ai phân biệt ngươi?' (Because who distinguishes you?). The Vietnamese 'Vì' incorrectly renders the Greek particle 'γαρ' (for/because) as a causal connector for the first clause, rather than a conjunction connecting the thought to the previous context. More importantly, the Greek implies 'Who can distinguish/separate you?' (often in the context of spiritual unity), while the Vietnamese phrasing can be interpreted as a question of 'Who distinguishes you' in a way that loses the nuance of the Greek 'τις'.
